description: This file defines the LeaveReportDataAPI class, a PHP API endpoint class responsible for handling leave report data requests within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base report class, includes API documentation annotations, and contains logic to validate report names and instantiate appropriate report classes.

classes.name: LeaveReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class that manages leave report data retrieval, extending the base ReportDataAPI and providing report validation and instantiation logic.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the specific report class instance based on the report name parameter; throws an exception if the report name is invalid.
